contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver, slightly clipped, siliqua of Constantinus II, AD337-361. Mint is Lyon, AD360-361. Reverse shows wreath inscribed VOTIS/XXX/MVLTIS/XXXX. See RIC VIII, p.193, no.216. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend reads DN CONSTAN-TIVS PF AVG. Reverse fields and exergue read: -//LVG.
